+@requires_lal
+@requires_bilby
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("approximant", ["TaylorF2", "IMRPhenomPv2_NRTidal"])
+def test_bns_tides_match_bilby_and_change_waveform(approximant):
+    """Validate the BNS path against the neutron-star source, including tides."""
+    import bilby
+
+    from hyperwave.detectors.waveforms.lal_backend import LALWaveform
+
+    farr = np.arange(0, 1024.25, 0.25)
+    params = dict(mass_1=1.4, mass_2=1.3, luminosity_distance=40,
+                  theta_jn=0.4, phase=0.3, a_1=0, a_2=0, tilt_1=0, tilt_2=0,
+                  phi_12=0, phi_jl=0, lambda_1=300, lambda_2=500)
+    waveform = LALWaveform(farr, approximant=approximant, reference_frequency=50,
+                          minimum_frequency=23, maximum_frequency=1024)
+    hp, hc = waveform.polarizations({k:[v] for k,v in params.items()})
+    reference = bilby.gw.source.lal_binary_neutron_star(
+        farr, **params, waveform_approximant=approximant,
+        reference_frequency=50, minimum_frequency=23, maximum_frequency=1024)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(hp[0], reference["plus"])
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(hc[0], reference["cross"])
+    no_tides = dict(params, lambda_1=0, lambda_2=0)
+    hp_zero, _ = waveform.polarizations({k:[v] for k,v in no_tides.items()})
+    assert np.linalg.norm(hp-hp_zero) / np.linalg.norm(hp) > 1e-3
+
